svg.title: Editorial Family F3-A2 — three selected anchor state boards
svg.desc: Six grayscale stress states for Lead Story, Evidence Aside and Across the Record, followed by strengths and known risks.
svg.text: All photography is original grayscale diagram content. Every frame remains cover-filled. White dashed boxes mark crop-risk zones; arrows, safe areas and binding lines are review overlays, never Renderer assets.

g.text: One decisive entry: title first, deck second, main photograph third. Note mode is none; title and photo never compete at equal weight.
subject near right edge · cover crop check
native state · no Note slot exists
Photo Note is preserved in data,
but no note geometry is created.
Title, deck and image remain legible.
Main photograph owns the entry; a narrow context lane contains label, optional Note 02 and subordinate evidence 02. Missing Note never moves either photograph.
landscape main + vertical detail + medium note
Use a detail, not a second scene.
Portrait main keeps a face centered.
Line count, not font size, gates.
03 — ACROSS THE RECORD · editorial-across-the-record-v1 · SPREAD / ROLE 11
Legal spread evidence is required Photo–Note cross-page-pair: Photo 01 remains left; Note 01 remains right. A shared grid, title or visual balance does not establish scope.
wide source inside near-square left frame
Use only if focal subject is central.
same spread, clipped as atomic pages
LEAD STORY — Strength: unmistakable title/deck/photo duty chain, strongest single-image Editorial entry. Risk: long titles can crowd the hierarchy; portrait sources lose context in the wide frame.

EVIDENCE ASIDE — Strength: main and evidence are visibly unequal; optional Note has a precise binding target and fixed lane. Risk: a scenic secondary photo is over-cropped and the pair can drift toward Quiet Scale Echo if evidence is not factual.

ACROSS THE RECORD — Strength: required Photo–Note evidence makes a legal, Editorial-only spread and differentiates it from Quiet’s cross-gutter panorama. Risk: missing Note invalidates the recipe; landscape sources need severe cover cropping.

VISUAL DECISION REQUEST — Confirm whether Lead Story’s title band is authoritative without overpowering the image; whether Evidence Aside’s narrow evidence frame is still readable; and whether Across the Record’s intentionally quiet right text page feels editorial rather than empty.
Black / white / gray only · page miniatures 3:4 · spread miniatures 3:2 · no copied source imagery, type, texture or coordinates.
